architectureDecisions: D1 — grokTool = defineAgentTool({ id: 'grok', command: 'grok', prefixArgs: [], versionArgs: ['--version'], buildInvocation, parseResult }). AGENT_TOOLS.grok = grokTool. Export grokTool and GROK_DEFAULT_MODEL = 'grok-4.6' from tool-adapters.js and index.js. Adapter never reads homedir or ~/.grok; operators use PATH or --command.

D2 — buildInvocation requires non-empty promptFile (TypeError like agy logFile) and uses spawn cwd via request.cwd when it is a non-empty string. Args (WORKSPACE_EDIT): ['--output-format','json','--model', model||GROK_DEFAULT_MODEL, ...(cwd?['--cwd',cwd]:[]), '--permission-mode','acceptEdits','--disable-web-search','--no-subagents','--no-auto-update', ...resumeArgs, '--prompt-file', promptFile]. FULL_AUTO replaces the permission-mode pair with '--always-approve'. Resume: sessionRef string → ['--resume', sessionRef]; resume non-null without sessionRef → ['--continue']; resume null → []. stdin is always null. Do not pass a positional prompt.

D3 — process-runner runAgentInvocation calls tool.buildInvocation({ ...request, timeoutMs, cwd }). Existing adapters ignore cwd. supervisor.js writes prompt to join(logDir, `attempt-${index}.prompt.txt`) and sets request { prompt, resume, model, permissionProfile, logFile, promptFile, cwd: workspace.root }. observation runObservedInvocation: if tool.id==='grok' and request.promptFile is missing, write the prompt to a temp file under os.tmpdir() (not cwd) and set promptFile; always set request.cwd. redactArgv already rebuilds from the same request.

D4 — parseResult reads the first JSON object in stdout: claimedSuccess = exitCode===0, sessionRef = string sessionId or null, finalMessage = string text sliced to 2000 chars or lastLines(stdout). parseGrokJson(stdout,{truncated}) maps usage.input_tokens→inputTokens, cache_read_input_tokens→cachedInputTokens, outputTokens, reasoning_tokens→reasoningOutputTokens, source 'grok.output.json', unavailableReason null only when inputTokens and outputTokens are integers (zero is observed). totalCostUsd is Number(total_cost_usd) when finite, else null (grok-only extra field; Codex/Kiro/agy usage objects stay {inputTokens,cachedInputTokens,outputTokens,reasoningOutputTokens,source,unavailableReason}). Missing/unparseable JSON → GROK_USAGE_NOT_REPORTED; truncated without those integers → GROK_JSON_TRUNCATED. toolEvents = { num_turns, stopReason, invalidJson: boolean } or null. parseToolOutput('grok', invocation) dispatches here; TOOL_UNAVAILABLE/TIMED_OUT keep existing reasons. summarizeTraces adds usage.totalCostUsdOverCoveredTraces as the sum of finite totalCostUsd on covered grok traces, else null.

D5 — CLI: USAGE and baseTool accept grok. probe iterates AGENT_TOOLS so grok appears as {installed,version}. smoke --tool grok uses the same skip reasons NOT_INSTALLED / TOOL_FAILED_BEFORE_EDIT. Root package.json smoke:agent-tools and test scripts unchanged except USAGE strings in comments/README. Live smoke stays out of npm test and npm run verify.

D6 — fake-grok.mjs: --version prints 'fake-grok 0.0.0'; reads --prompt-file contents as the prompt; honors FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO like fake-agent.mjs (FIX_FIRST writes the built-in sum fix); prints one JSON object { text, stopReason:'end_turn', sessionId:'fake-grok-N', requestId:'req-N', num_turns, usage:{input_tokens,cache_read_input_tokens,cache_creation_input_tokens,output_tokens,reasoning_tokens,total_tokens}, total_cost_usd, total_cost_usd_ticks, modelUsage:{} }. Fixtures grok-usage.json and grok-no-usage.json cover the parser. Tests never spawn a real grok binary.

D7 — Evidence: executed grok-cli-probe-result.json (version 1.0.44, --prompt-file live edit hello.txt=hi with JSON usage/cost/sessionId, positional ENXIO, ENOENT missing binary, --no-auto-update hidden, grok not on default PATH). Delivered AGENT_TOOLS / parseToolOutput / runSupervisedTask / runObservedInvocation.

D8 — Living docs: state.md adapter table and CLI USAGE include grok; observation.md per-tool row for grok JSON usage/cost; docs/living/system/state.md one-line inventory; packages/agent-tools/README.md. Living docs contain no Blackboard ids.

S2 — Parser and traces [GR2]: implement D4 parseGrokJson, parseToolOutput grok, UsageUnavailableReason additions, optional report totalCostUsdOverCoveredTraces. Fixture grok-usage.json / grok-no-usage.json. Prompt sha256 present; argvRedacted contains no prompt string.
